description: Defines the PortRangeSocketFactory class which extends rtc::BasicPacketSocketFactory to create UDP and TCP sockets within specified port ranges for WebRTC streaming in the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: PortRangeSocketFactory
classes.description: A socket factory that creates UDP and TCP sockets within specified port ranges, extending rtc::BasicPacketSocketFactory.

methods.name: PortRangeSocketFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket factory with a base socket factory and port ranges for UDP and TCP.

methods.name: CreateUdpSocket
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket within the specified port range.

methods.name: CreateServerTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket within the specified port range.
